title: a memorial, a page anyone can edit
line: the rule takes its subject as an identity (the name, both dates to the day, the burial place and the relatives it lists agreeing with the tree's claims), writes every fact undecided and none accepted; the relatives it lists come up as cards and are refused with the reason; a rejection writes nothing else; a new person accepted is created with her marked maiden name as her birth surname and the subject placed as her child with an undecided membership; reconsider keeps the identity, a withdrawn one is taken again; a re-read carries the decided links and accepts no fact; the owner's accept is an identity too; the daughter listed under her married name fits and her accept writes a married_name alias; the subject holds the cemetery row, a listed relative never does; the gravestone photograph is a fetch step saved under the list's name, brought in by collect, archived tier 1 unparsed, and a reading of it by the model is a card the rule leaves to the owner

expect.why: the rule takes the memorial's subject as an identity on a page anyone can edit; its reason names the day of birth, the day of death, the burial place and the relatives listed
every fact the page types is written undecided, none accepted
a page anyone can edit builds no fact
his wife and daughter proposed once he is accepted
a relative the page lists by name and years alone is refused, the stated relation the one thing that agrees
his parents and siblings, not in the tree, proposed as new people
a page anyone can edit names a person but never creates one

steps.say: a sibling's card rejected: the proposal and nothing else
his mother accepted as a new person

expect.why: the subject placed as the new parent's child on the record, the membership created but its assertion undecided like the page's facts
the person created with the name as written and the marked maiden name as her birth surname

steps.say: reconsider keeps the identity and refuses the listed relatives with the reason
a card the rule would take is taken by reconsider, recorded as the rule
the page read again while the rule's decision stands: the link carries to the new persona

expect.why: the memorial's subject through the current reading

steps.say: the decision withdrawn after a re-read resets both personas: the decision is about the record, not one reading of it

expect.why: withdrawn, no citation of his is held through an accepted subject persona, the earlier reading's link included

steps.say: the owner gives the identity: an identity still, the facts undecided, every reading's persona linked

expect.why: the owner's decision applies to every reading's persona of that name and role on the record

steps.say: the daughter the page lists under her married name accepted by the owner: an identity, and her married name an alias

expect.why: the record's own words for a daughter under her husband's surname are a married_name alias, not left unclassified
the memorial's own subject holds the cemetery row
a relative the page merely lists never holds the row, even accepted: her own memorial is not on this tree

steps.say: the page read again: the decided links carry, the old cards close as superseded, the facts stay undecided

expect.why: the three decided links (the subject, his mother, his daughter) carried to the new personas

steps.say: the subject's plan: the one photograph the page types Grave is a fetch step under the cemetery row

expect.why: one fetch step, for the photograph typed Grave, with the image's URL as locator; the family photographs make none
the fetch list names the image and the file to save it under

steps.say: the photograph saved in the browser under that name, into the download folder

expect.why: the entry's link is the step's locator

steps.say: collect brings the saved image in: it reaches its step by the list's name and is not parsed

expect.why: the image reaches its step by the list's name and is not parsed
the file has left the download folder
archived under the gravestone row, an image, tier 1

steps.say: the stone read by the model: a card for the subject the rule leaves to the owner

expect.why: the model's extractor row carries the model named after llm: and the hash of the form's field names, the only prompt there is
a reading of the stone is a kind the rule may take, refused for the true reason: the subject's own name is not yet accepted on this tree, not for who read it

steps.say: the plan settled and the catalog whole
